risks.risk: Engine not working or in poor condition
risks.proof: Photo of the engine bay with visible components, ideally running or with oil and coolant levels checked.
Photo of the gear lever and transmission housing, or a video of the gear shifting.

risks.risk: Hidden structural damage or rust under the body panels
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the chassis, frame, and undercarriage, especially around the axles and suspension.
Full side view photo showing all tires, or a count of tires from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having fewer than 12 tires or worn tires

proof_requests: Photo of the engine bay showing the engine and its condition.
Photo or video of the gear lever and transmission operation.
Full side view photo showing all tires to confirm the 12-tire claim.
Close-up photos of the chassis and undercarriage for rust or damage.
response.reason: The truck is identifiable as a DAF CF, but key claims about the engine, gear, and tire count cannot be verified from the current photos. Hidden risks related to mechanical condition and structural integrity require additional proof before pricing can be determined.
